senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
City, citizen, relating to or produced in a town or city.
n. (-रं)
A fragrant grass.
E.
पुर a city, aff. अण्.

n. (-कं)
A garden round a house.
E.
पौर citizen, and कन् added.

m. (-नः)
A citizen.
E.
पौर, जन person.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Of the race of Puru, descended from Puru.
E.
पुरु, and अण् aff.

n. (-ख्यं)
Connexion or equality by inhabiting the same city for ten years, fellow-citizenship.
E.
पौर relating to a city, सख्य friendship.

mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं)
Prior, first, initial.
E.
पुरस् formerly, अण् aff. of relation, पौरस्, and त्यक् aff.

f. (-स्त्री)
A woman residing in a town or city.
E.
पौरा, and स्त्री a female; also similar compounds, as पौरयोषित, पौराङ्गना, &c.

mfn. (-णः-णी-णं)
Relating to the Purāṇas.
E.
पुराण, and अण् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or belonging to the Purāṇas, Paurānic.
m. (-कः)
A Brahman, well read in the Purāṇas.
E.
पुराल, and ठक् aff.

mfn. subst. (-षः-षी-षं)
The measure of a man, equal to the height to which he reaches with both arms elevated, and the fingers extended.
adj.
Manly, of or belonging to man.
n. (-षं)
1 The property of manhood, virility, manliness.
2 Action, or action incidental to the state of humanity.
3 Semen virile.
4 Strength, power, vigour.
E.
पुरुष a man, aff. अण्.

f. (-ता)
Manhood, manly strength or spirit.
E.
तल् added to पौरुष; also with त्व, पौरुषत्व.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made by, derived from, or relating to man, human, manly, virile, &c.
m. (-यः)
1 A crowd, or number of men.
2 Manslaughter, murder.
3 Law, as affecting persons.
E.
पुरुष a man, and ढक् aff.

mf. (-वः-वी)
Overseer or superintendant of the kitchen.
E.
पुरुस् first, गौ the eye, aff. अण्.

m. (-शः)
A prayer recited upon making an oblation of clarified butter.
E.
पुरोडाश butter offered to fire, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A priest who recites the prayer used in offering an oblation of clarified butter.
E.
पौरोडाश, and ठन् aff.

n. (-त्यं)
The character or functions of family priest.
E.
पुरोहित, and ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-सः)
A ceremony performed at the full of the moon, by persons maintaining a perpetual fire.
f. (-सी)
Day of full moon.
E.
पूर्णमास a rite, &c. aff. अण्.

m. (-मः)
An ascetic.
f. (-मा)
Day of full moon.
E.
पूर्णिमा, and अण् pleonasm.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Sacrificial, ceremonial.
E.
पूर्त्त, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-र्व्वः-र्व्वी-र्व्वं)
Relating, or belonging to the past, to the east, &c.
E.
पूर्व्व, and अञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to the first member of a compound.
E.
पूर्व्वपद, and ठञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging to a former body or existence.
E.
पूर्व्वदेह, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Dwelling or being in the eastern division of a town, &c.
E.
पूर्व्वार्द्ध eastern half or part, and ठञ् aff.; also with घञ्, पौर्व्वार्द्ध; and with यत्, पूर्व्वार्द्ध.

n. (-य्यं)
Priority and subsequence.
E.
पूर्व्वापर first and last, ष्यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Belonging or relating to or produced in the forepart of the day.
E.
पूर्व्वाह्ण forenoon, aff. ठञ्.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Prior, primary, former.
E.
पूर्व्व, and ठक् aff.
